journey.title: Opt out of reminders with the keyboard after choosing Text message
journey.goal: Arrowing from Text message to the opt-out answer hides the mobile number field that no longer applies

plan.root_cause: The radios component only updates aria-expanded and conditional visibility on click events, not on keyboard-driven change events, causing conditionals to remain visible when focus moves via arrow keys.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a change event listener to the radios module that invokes setAttributes on the changed radio when it has aria-controls, ensuring ARIA attributes and visibility are updated for keyboard interaction.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow key navigation between radios will correctly show/hide associated conditional fields, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Both click and change events may fire for mouse interactions; setAttributes is idempotent so impact is minimal.
If other code relies on the ordering of change events, adding this listener could affect timing.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting a radio via arrow keys updates aria-expanded and hides/shows the correct conditional field.
Verify that clicking a radio continues to work as before.
Ensure form values update correctly for both keyboard and mouse interaction.
Confirm no regression in existing click‑based behavior for other radios on the page.

plan.root_cause: The radios component only updates conditional visibility on click events within its own module, missing keyboard-driven change events on radios outside the module but in the same radio group (same name), causing conditionals to remain visible when focus moves via arrow keys.
plan.repair_strategy: Add a document-level change event listener for the radio group name in each Radios instance, which triggers an update of all conditional fields in that module based on the checked state of its radios. This ensures keyboard navigation across modules updates visibility correctly.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Arrow key navigation between radios in the same group but across modules will correctly show/hide associated conditional fields, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.3 Focus Order.
functional_risks: Multiple Radios instances for the same radio group will each add a document change listener, causing duplicate updates (idempotent, minimal impact).
The document change listener fires for any radio with the same name, potentially updating modules that don't contain that radio (harmless).
If other code relies on the exact timing of change events, the additional listener could affect order (unlikely).
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting a radio via arrow keys updates aria-expanded and hides/shows the correct conditional field.
Verify that clicking a radio continues to work as before.
Ensure form values update correctly for both keyboard and mouse interaction.
Confirm no regression in existing click‑based behavior for other radios on the page.
Test that opting out after selecting Text message hides the mobile number field.
